action_sequence_note: Full from-fresh-reset sequence: 33-action banked L1 prefix + 61-action L2 suffix (both previously reproduction-verified) + 76-action L3 suffix found this session, single continuous episode, no resets. Verified via arc_solver_kit.reproduce claimed_level=3.
novel_hypothesis_tested: FENCE-SOCKET RELAY: L3 splits the map with a full-height dashed fence (tile col 8) -- player + 3 blocks on the left, helper robot + bay on the right, and 2 of the 5 blocks pre-embedded IN the fence line. Extracting a fence block does NOT open a passage (the fence regenerates behind it, disproving the hole hypothesis), and the fence is never crossed by either worker. Instead, any fence tile acts as a SOCKET: a carried block may be dropped INTO the fence line from the west (the ghost-onto-fence move is legal), where the robot can extract it from the east and ferry it to the bay. The level is solved as a relay: the player sockets the 3 left-side blocks into the fence at (5,8), (4,8), (11,8); the robot autonomously extracts each socket plus the 2 pre-embedded fence blocks and makes all 5 bay placements. The two workers never share a side, so unlike L2 there are no mutual-blocking collisions.
narrative: Replayed the verified 94-action L1+L2 prefix (levels_completed=2, fresh 64-cell timer -- nothing carries over across the level transition, no reset occurs between levels). Recon showed the vertical barrier is a full-height fence with two of the five blocks embedded in it, the robot and bay on the far side. First probe: the robot extracted the (3,8) fence block on its own and the fence texture filled back in -- no hole opens, so neither the player nor blocks can ever cross. Second probe: while carrying a block, the move that put its ghost onto fence tile (5,8) was ALLOWED, and ACTION5 socketed the block into the fence, after which the robot extracted it from the east side and placed it in the bay. From there the solve was a pipeline: player fetched (5,5), (4,2), (11,3) (each picked up from the west so the carried block trails east) and socketed them at (5,8), (4,8), (11,8); the robot autonomously delivered all five blocks (two pre-embedded + three relayed) into bay slots (6,13),(6,14),(7,13),(8,13),(9,13)-area. Final placement landed on ACTION5 pump 14 with 16 timer cells to spare; levels_completed hit 3 and the timer refreshed to 64 on entry to L4. The 170-action full sequence reproduced from a fresh env.reset (reached_level=3). L3 timer drain measured ~0.64 cells/action (gentler than L2s ~0.85). Bonus recon: L4 is a larger multi-agent variant -- THREE helper robots, multiple small bays in the corners, color-5 wall segments forming a maze, and 7+ blocks inside a fenced central enclosure.
l3_gotchas: Fence blocks are ordinary pickable blocks; extraction does not open a passage (fence regenerates).
Any fence tile accepts a socketed block: move-with-ghost-onto-fence is legal only for the drop, the player still cannot stand on fence tiles.
Pick up left-side blocks from their WEST side so the carried ghost trails EAST; only a ghost-east carry can reach a fence socket from the left half.
Do not pump ACTION5 while adjacent-facing your own socketed block -- it would pick it back up; step away first.
The robot happily extracts player-socketed blocks: nearest-loose-block targeting treats sockets as ordinary loose blocks.
L2->L3 transition: no reset, timer refills to 64, layout is fresh; suffixes concatenate directly for the reproduction gate.
random_seed_note: Deterministic offline environment; no RNG used by the agent.
duration_note: Wall-clock of the interactive REPL session (process elapsed time), covering prefix replay + L3 recon/solve + reproduction gate.
